title: Office refurbishment
summary: Upgrades to working offices, planned to keep disruption low and sites safe and clean.
intro: When an office needs new life rather than a new address, we rework layouts, finishes, lighting and electrical in the space you already have, with safety and hygiene managed around the people still using the building.

points.title: Work around your teams
points.text: Works are sequenced with you so the business keeps running.

points.title: Safe, clean sites
points.text: ISO 45001 practices protect your staff, visitors and our team in occupied buildings.

points.title: Keep what works
points.text: We keep original features and good fittings where they matter, and replace what holds you back.

points.title: Less waste
points.text: Usable materials from demolition are donated to local charities and recycling centres.

faqs.question: Can you work while our team is in the office?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our ISO 45001 practices cover safety and hygiene in buildings that are already in use, and we plan the order of work with you so your teams can keep working.

metaDescription: Office refurbishment and renovation in Mumbai, planned around working teams, with safe, clean ISO 45001 sites.
